roles.source_role: Twenty rare-variant genetic PCs for an All of Us LoF burden analysis; sixteen common-variant PCs were supplied separately by the release.
roles.runtime_scope: Explicit selected original major-2 PCA profile on the actual supplied BED/BIM/FAM rare-variant sample/marker population, with twenty requested components and complete source scaling/output checks.
roles.remaining_scope: The paper does not report the exact software patch, seed, random-panel membership or sampling fraction. The supplied sixteen common PCs are not recomputed by this FlashPCA task. The reported phenotype filtering, 213,787 sequenced participants with MCH, latest-visit selection, LoF annotation and downstream burden analysis remain separate.

roles.source_role: Twenty genetic PCs on 337,129 white British UK Biobank individuals as GWAS covariates.
roles.runtime_scope: Separately tested original legacy 1.2.6 and modern 2.0 profiles preserve different scales/score conventions; the caller must select an edition explicitly. A 2014 method citation does not prove the exact executed author binary.
roles.remaining_scope: Exact author software edition/patch and supplementary sample/marker QC are unresolved. PLINK2 logistic/linear GWAS, phenotype imputation, array coding, phenotype populations and METASOFT heterogeneity are separate; a generic Java PCA is not substituted for the original runtime.

roles.source_role: Twenty genotype PCs, eigenvalues, SNP loadings and variance explained from a specifically QC-filtered 68,619-SNP array panel.
roles.runtime_scope: Explicit original major-2 source profile with complete PCs, eigenvectors, eigenvalues, A1 loadings, SNP moments and trace-based PVE; exact author patch is not recovered from its method citation.
roles.remaining_scope: The source separately describes sample QC, MAF >=0.1% and HWE >1e-6, exclusion of 20,567 structural/MHC-region SNPs, common-MAF >5%, missingness <0.002 and LD r2<0.1 in 1,000-SNP windows. Actual membership and these preparations remain caller responsibilities; no author filter/sample population or downstream GWAS is reproduced.

roles.source_role: Genetic PCs on a prepared ATLAS genotype panel for subsequent ancestry assignment and association preparation.
roles.runtime_scope: Original unchanged v2.0 source-built PCA on caller-prepared BED/BIM/FAM genotypes, with exact sample/variant/A1 population and complete numeric output audits.
roles.remaining_scope: The MAF <15% wording is preserved rather than inverted to a conventional lower MAF filter. The PC count, actual panel membership, lift-over, missingness/strand-ambiguity QC and 1000 Genomes/KNN ancestry labels are not inferred. Phecode mapping and exclusion of ambiguous ancestry or absent phenotypes remain separate.
